blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative the quantity x minus six.
A negative sign in front of parentheses means negative one times them.
Distribute the negative one. Negative one times x, plus negative one times negative six.
Negative one times x is negative x. Negative one times negative six is positive six.
So the answer is negative x plus six.
Watch out for these traps. If you flip only the first sign, you get negative x minus six. If you ignore the negative in front, you get x minus six.
